description: React functional component defining keyboard shortcut handlers for a note-taking application, integrating Redux state management, formatting with Prettier, and custom hooks.

methods.name: newNoteHandler
methods.description: Handles creation of a new note, invoking helper with current state and dispatch functions.

methods.name: newTempCategoryHandler
methods.description: Sets state to add a temporary category if not already adding one.

methods.name: trashNoteHandler
methods.description: Triggers trashing of the active note.

methods.name: downloadNotesHandler
methods.description: Downloads selected notes if any are selected.

methods.name: toggleDarkThemeHandler
methods.description: Toggles dark theme and updates CodeMirror theme accordingly.

methods.name: prettifyNoteHandler
methods.description: Formats current note text with Prettier.
